query:
SELECT id, title, slug, excerpt, coverImageUrl, 
  CASE 
    WHEN blocks IS NULL THEN 'NO BLOCKS'
    WHEN JSON_LENGTH(blocks) = 0 THEN 'EMPTY BLOCKS'
    ELSE CONCAT('HAS ', JSON_LENGTH(blocks), ' BLOCKS')
  END as content_status,
  CASE 
    WHEN coverImageUrl IS NULL OR coverImageUrl = '' THEN 'NO IMAGE'
    ELSE 'HAS IMAGE'
  END as image_status
FROM news 
ORDER BY date DESC;

  END as content_status,

    ELSE 'HAS IMAGE'
  END as image_status
FROM news

rows.title: Returning to New Swan Theatre Festival in 2026
rows.excerpt: Scenic designer Brandon PT Davis returns to the New Swan Shakespeare Festival for the 2026 season, bringing his narrative-driven design approach to a repertory lineup spanning two distinct American eras.

rows.title: The Orange Curtain Review Praises Million Dollar Quartet at South Coast Repertory
rows.excerpt: The Orange Curtain Review praises Million Dollar Quartet at South Coast Repertory for its high-energy performances and thoughtful engagement with the cultural and economic realities behind early rock ’n’ roll.

rows.excerpt: Co-designing my first production at South Coast Repertory, one of the nation's leading regional theaters.

rows.title: Assisting Tom Buderwitz on The Play That Goes Wrong at Seattle Rep
rows.excerpt: Working with Tom Buderwitz on this hilarious comedy at Seattle Repertory Theatre.

rows.title: 40 Productions at Okoboji Summer Theatre
rows.excerpt: Celebrating a milestone: my 40th scenic design for Okoboji Summer Theatre.

rows.title: Opening Night: Deathtrap at Okoboji Summer Theatre
rows.excerpt: Ira Levin's clever thriller opens at OST.

rows.title: Fifth Season Assisting Jo Winiarski — Utah Shakespeare Festival
rows.excerpt: Returning for my fifth season as assistant scenic designer at Utah Shakespeare Festival.

rows.title: My Season as Scenic Designer for New Swan Shakespeare Festival (2025)
rows.excerpt: Designing two Shakespeare productions for New Swan's outdoor amphitheater.

rows.title: Opening Night: Romero at University of Missouri
rows.excerpt: World premiere production exploring the life and martyrdom of Archbishop Óscar Romero.

rows.title: Scenic Design for Okoboji Summer Theatre — Summer 2025 Season
rows.excerpt: I’m excited to return to Okoboji Summer Theatre as the scenic designer for three productions in the 2025 season. This summer’s lineup spans romantic comedy, psychological thriller, and classic musical theatre—offering a dynamic range of storytelling and design challenges in a place that continues to feel like a creative home.

rows.title: Shut Up, Sherlock Praised in SLO Review
rows.excerpt: The Great American Melodrama's production receives positive review.

rows.title: Opening Night: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying at OST
rows.excerpt: The classic Pulitzer Prize-winning musical opens at Okoboji Summer Theatre.

rows.title: Guys on Ice Receives Praise in SLO Review
rows.excerpt: Guys on Ice at The Great American Melodrama received a warm and generous review from SLO Review, praising the production’s heart, humor, and collaborative craft. The review specifically highlights my scenic design, noting how the intimate ice shanty setting supports the show’s slice-of-life storytelling and emotional warmth.

rows.title: Freaky Friday at Okoboji Summer Theatre Receives Praise
rows.excerpt: Local critics praise the inventive scenic design for this family musical.

rows.title: Joining United Scenic Artists, Local USA 829
rows.excerpt: Officially joining the union for professional scenic, lighting, and costume designers.

rows.title: Forum at Theatre SilCo Featured in Summit Daily

rows.title: Scenic Design for ¡Lotería: Game On! at Theatre SilCo
rows.excerpt: Immersive bilingual production blending theatre and game show elements.

rows.title: Assisting My First Off-Broadway Show — The Fears (April–May 2023)
rows.excerpt: Assistant scenic designer for The Fears at Pershing Square Signature Center in New York.

rows.title: Stephens College Update: Looking Ahead to Spring 2022
rows.excerpt: Updates on teaching and productions at Stephens College.

rows.title: Returning to Stephens College as Assistant Professor of Scenic Design
rows.excerpt: Joining the faculty at Stephens College to teach scenic design.

rows.excerpt: Immersive scenic design for Aristophanes' Greek comedy.

rows.title: Graduating from UCI in the Middle of a Pandemic
rows.excerpt: Completing my MFA during the COVID-19 pandemic.

rows.title: New Role at UTEP — Assistant Professor of Scenic Design & Technology
rows.excerpt: Starting a new position at University of Texas El Paso.

rows.title: Company at UC Irvine Highlighted in StageSceneLA
rows.excerpt: Production receives critical acclaim from Los Angeles theatre critics.

rows.title: The Pajama Game Receives Praise from StageSceneLA
rows.excerpt: StageSceneLA praised UC Irvine’s 2019 production of The Pajama Game, citing Brandon PT Davis’s stylish scenic design as part of a professional-caliber production that brought renewed relevance to the Golden Age musical.

rows.title: Scenic Design for Parliament Square — California Premiere at UCI
rows.excerpt: Scenic designer Brandon PT Davis designed the set for the California premiere of Parliament Square at the University of California, Irvine, creating a visually sparse environment that amplified the play’s themes of protest, sacrifice, and conviction.

rows.title: American Idiot at UC Irvine Reviewed in The Show Report
rows.excerpt: Scenic designer Brandon PT Davis designed the set for UC Irvine’s 2018 production of American Idiot, with The Show Report praising the dynamic scenic environment as a key contributor to the production’s impact.

rows.title: Heading to UC Irvine for My MFA
rows.excerpt: Discover my journey to UC Irvine for an MFA. Explore insights, tips, and experiences as I embark on this academic and creative adventure.

rows.excerpt: Production at The Great American Melodrama receives acclaim.
